title: Careers at Gemcon City
description: Open roles at Gemcon City Limited in sales, engineering, architecture, finance and marketing. Apply online with your CV.

data.title: Careers at Gemcon City
data.intro: Engineers, architects, sales advisors and finance people who like to finish what they start. Join the team that builds homes Dhaka families keep for generations.

data.heading: Work you can point at
data.body:
Every project we take on ends with a building that families move into. Our teams see their work go from drawings to keys, often within two years, and stay with it after handover.

We keep teams small, give people real responsibility early and promote from within: most of our project managers started as site engineers.

items.title: Fair, on-time pay
items.text: Salaries paid on the first working day, two festival bonuses and a provident fund after confirmation.

items.title: Health cover
items.text: Medical cover for you, your spouse and your children from your first month.

items.title: Room to grow
items.text: A training budget for every team, and promotions from within before we hire from outside.
